_doc: Fog-of-war value head for the finished Curio hero checkpoint: the scratch-fog-head-1 / bn4-foghead recipe (docs/scratch-search-2026-10-23.md). No omniscient critic, critic_warmup past the run's end, so every gradient except critic_hidden and value is zeroed and the policy stays bitwise identical (Adam with zero gradients is an exact no-op). Pure self-play (no historical pool). training_seconds is filled in at launch (default 3600). stream_views is OFF on Curio: DeviceRows page streaming deadlocked the 4-GPU allreduce on this host (trial a-stream-off vs control, 2026-10-31). coded_views on: actors send sparse row deltas, the learner decodes on the GPUs (66k vs 35k samples/s, trial t2). no_peace on and capped games are 0-0 draws (cap_score_reward 0, truncation_reward 0): with peace allowed and score-at-cap wins, self-play settled into peace until the cap (hero-1v1-scratch-v2, 2026-11-01).
